entities.name: Víctor Luís Quematcha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor Luís Quematcha O.F.M. is a Bissau-Guinean Catholic prelate who was appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bafatá, in Guinea-Bissau on 8 March 2025. Before that, from 2 May 1998 until 8 March 2025, he was a priest of the Order of Friars Minor. He was consecrated and installed at Bafatá, Diocese of Bafatá, on 28 June 2025 by Waldemar Stanisław Sommertag, Titular Archbishop of Traiectum ad Mosam.
